description: Trial005 sampling-only retry from trial004's predesignated final checkpoint. Replace last-substep wheel-link vertical-velocity cost with the arithmetic mean over all four refreshed 200 Hz substeps. Weight, normalization, other rewards, reference, PD, friction, motor randomization, contact settings and behavior gates remain unchanged. This corrects reward quadrature, not established contact-model equivalence. Activate only after the actual Isaac runtime smoke passes. Evaluate only the final checkpoint after 600 additional PPO updates; retain any failure. No hardware or statistical robustness claim.
